behaviors.search-assignees: Typing a person’s name in the Assignee dropdown search narrows the available assignee options.
behaviors.filter-by-assignee: Selecting an assignee filters the board to that person’s tasks and shows task counts beside the assignee options.
behaviors.filter-unassigned: Selecting Unassigned filters the board to tasks with no assignee.
behaviors.assignee-empty-state: Selecting Ana Lima, who has no seeded tasks, shows a personalized empty state with a Clear filters action.
behaviors.clear-filters: Clear filters resets both status and assignee filters and restores all tasks to the board.

history.notes: Uses the dropdown’s visible search, option labels, task headings, and summary text. Assumes the status filter is the board toolbar’s native select and the empty-state Clear filters button is scoped inside `.empty`.
